t: This is Fall, a sculpture by Alan Thornhill, who lived from 1921 to 2020. Thornhill was a British artist whose work with clay began in pottery and grew into sculpture. He also made portrait heads, paintings and drawings. He evolved ways of working that did away with the sculptural armature, which let him improvise while modelling. His portraiture is described as challenging notions of normality through rigorous observation. Look closely at the piece and see how that spirit of free, attentive making comes through.
